name: Coding Agent Workbench and Documentation
description: Build a workspace-aware coding agent workbench with live analysis, task-file input, model selection, agent planning and execution, review and verification controls, alongside the existing documentation normalization work.

tasks.name: Documentation Inventory and Content Review
tasks.modelRationale: File inventory, classification, metadata extraction. DeepSeek 3.2 is cost-optimized for file operations with good quality.
deliverables: Inventory documentation across the repository, including Markdown, text, and API reference files
Read each document's metadata and actual contents before deciding its destination or disposition
Classify documents as active, completed, historical, duplicate, or obsolete
Identify canonical topic documents, conflicting guidance, inbound links, and ownership

tasks.name: Document Summary Metadata Standard
tasks.modelRationale: Template creation and systematic application. DeepSeek V4-Flash handles pattern-based work well at minimal cost.
deliverables: Define a concise, consistent metadata summary block at the top of each maintained document
Include the document purpose, scope, intended audience, and current status where applicable
Write summaries from both the document metadata and its actual content rather than filename alone
Apply and verify the summary block across all retained documentation, including completed documents moved to the archive, while preserving required formats

tasks.name: Redundant Documentation Consolidation
tasks.modelRationale: Complex comparison and conflict resolution. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini) offers 7.5/10 reasoning at fraction of cost. Escalate to glm-4-plus or R1 if reasoning insufficient.
deliverables: Compare metadata summaries and actual text to detect duplicate or overlapping material
Merge redundant documentation into one canonical file per topic and reconcile conflicting guidance
Preserve unique, current information and maintain distinct documents where audiences or interfaces differ
Update inbound references before removing superseded duplicate files

tasks.name: Documentation Structure and File Relocation
tasks.modelRationale: File moves, link updates - mechanical restructuring. DeepSeek V4-Flash is ideal for file operations (cost: $0.98 vs $16.00).
deliverables: Keep README.md and the Getting Started document (currently QUICKSTART.md) at the repository root
Move other project documentation from the root into a logical structure under docs/
Arrange active documentation into topic-based sections with a clear index or navigation entry point
Move completed documentation into docs/completed/ and keep active guidance out of the completed archive
Update links and references to reflect all moves

tasks.name: Interface Documentation Organization
tasks.modelRationale: Documentation placement and linking. DeepSeek V4-Flash is cost-effective for straightforward organization tasks.
deliverables: Place MCP, orchestration-tool, CLI, and API documentation in the agreed docs structure
Keep separate interface-specific setup and reference material while linking shared concepts to canonical docs
Ensure examples and configuration guidance agree with the implemented interface contracts
Add the interface guides to documentation navigation

tasks.name: Documentation Reference and Structure Validation
tasks.modelRationale: Link validation and structure checking - automated verification tasks suit DeepSeek V4-Flash well.
deliverables: Validate internal Markdown links, relative paths, and documentation navigation
Check that root-level documentation exceptions and docs/completed/ placement follow the agreed structure
Detect remaining duplicate or unclassified documentation and report exceptions
Add a repeatable documentation validation check to the project workflow

tasks.name: Workspace and Package-Driven Linter Configuration
tasks.modelRationale: Complex workspace resolution and discovery logic. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini, 7/10 reasoning) handles this well. Escalate to glm-4-plus if needed.
deliverables: Resolve the active project root from the opened workspace or an explicit folder selection; never hard-code a developer-specific absolute path
Read the selected project's package.json, including scripts and dependencies, to discover supported lint, test, and analysis commands
Provide an editable default linter selection based on detected and installed tools, with per-project persistence and a clear unavailable state
Run only selected tools against the selected project and normalize their findings with source file, rule, line, and severity data
Add fixture-based tests proving discovery uses the selected project's package.json rather than the tool's own package.json

tasks.name: Task File Import and Task Selection
tasks.modelRationale: JSON parsing, validation, UI display - well-defined implementation. DeepSeek V4-Flash is 94% cheaper than Haiku.
deliverables: Add a file-picker and drag-and-drop option for selecting a task JSON file by path
Parse supported task arrays and grouped task collections without losing task IDs, status, priority, dependencies, or descriptions
Support the repository's phase task format, including phase8-tasks.json, and validate malformed or unsupported input with actionable errors
Display imported tasks in a selectable queue and let users choose one or more tasks for an agent run
Keep the selected task file and imported task list scoped to the current workspace/session and provide a refresh or replace action

tasks.name: Provider and Model Selection
tasks.modelRationale: Security-critical credential/provider logic. glm-5 (90% security accuracy, equivalent to o1-mini) is ideal. Escalate to glm-4-plus or glm-5-plus for highest stakes.
deliverables: Add a model dropdown populated from configured local and cloud providers rather than a hard-coded list
Show provider, model, availability, and capability information, and prevent selecting unavailable models
Allow a workspace default and an optional per-task model override, with a visible Auto option that reports the resolved model
Keep credentials in environment variables or an operating-system secret store and never persist secrets in workspace settings
Add provider connectivity checks and explicit errors for missing credentials, offline models, rate limits, and budget limits

tasks.name: Agent Planning and Work Orchestration
tasks.modelRationale: CRITICAL: Dependency ordering, concurrency, retries. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini with 7/10 reasoning) surprisingly handles this well. glm-5 for deep reasoning if needed.
deliverables: Accept a coding request or selected task and produce a reviewable plan with ordered steps, affected files, expected checks, and risks
Break work into independently trackable work items and assign each item to a named agent or worker with an explicit model and tool policy
Track dependencies, concurrency limits, retries, blocked work, and cancellation without reporting unexecuted work as complete
Require user confirmation before starting plans that exceed configured permission or resource limits
Add deterministic orchestration tests for planning, task dependency ordering, failure propagation, and partial completion

tasks.name: Agent Assignment and Live Work Activity View
tasks.modelRationale: UI state management, event streaming - implementation after architecture defined. DeepSeek V4-Flash is cost-effective.
deliverables: Show each selected issue or task as a row with its assigned agent, selected model, current step, elapsed time, and result
Use explicit queued, planning, working, awaiting approval, verifying, completed, failed, and cancelled states sourced from orchestration events
Stream progress and tool activity into an inspectable event list while keeping the active work item and overall queue visible
Allow users to inspect an agent's current task, output, changed files, and failure details without conflating parallel runs
Add UI tests for state changes, simultaneous workers, errors, and empty/loading states

tasks.name: Workspace Context and Instruction Assembly
tasks.modelRationale: Complex context gathering, token budget calculations. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini, 7/10 reasoning) handles this well. glm-4-plus for edge cases.
deliverables: Let users attach the current file, editor selection, task file, diagnostics, and explicitly chosen workspace files to a request
Load applicable repository guidance such as AGENTS.md and project-specific instruction files and show which guidance was applied
Use workspace search, symbol references, and bounded code context to gather relevant source instead of sending the whole repository by default
Respect ignore rules, generated/build directories, file-size limits, and configurable context/token budgets
Show the context sources and estimated token usage before execution and test that excluded files never enter model prompts

tasks.name: Coding Agent Tool Registry and Execution
tasks.modelRationale: CRITICAL: Tool contract design, validation logic, security. glm-5 (equivalent to o1-mini) for reasoning. glm-4-plus as fallback.
deliverables: Expose typed agent tools for reading files, searching text and symbols, listing files, editing files, and inspecting diagnostics or diffs
Provide controlled terminal, selected-linter, build, and test tools with structured inputs, outputs, exit codes, and bounded logs
Validate tool arguments and workspace paths, enforce timeouts and output limits, and return actionable failures to the agent
Record every tool invocation and result in the active work item so users can inspect what the agent actually did
Add isolated tool-contract tests and integration tests using temporary workspaces

tasks.name: Execution Permissions and Workspace Safety
tasks.modelRationale: CRITICAL: Security boundaries, path validation, secret redaction. glm-5 (equivalent to o1-mini) for reasoning. Escalate to glm-5-plus for maximum safety.
deliverables: Provide clear approval modes for read-only, approval-required, and explicitly trusted operations, with safe defaults
Require confirmation for terminal commands and file writes according to policy and show the exact command, working directory, or target files
Constrain file operations to the selected workspace and guard against traversal, symlink escapes, and destructive commands
Redact secrets from prompts, tool output, and logs, and require explicit consent before sending source to a cloud provider
Add security tests for path escapes, command policy, secret redaction, cancellation, and denied operations

tasks.name: Diff Review, Apply, Reject, and Rollback
tasks.modelRationale: File diff generation, atomic writes, backup/restore - well-established patterns. DeepSeek V4-Flash is cost-optimal.
deliverables: Present proposed edits as file-grouped unified diffs with added, removed, and unchanged context clearly distinguished
Allow users to apply or reject individual file changes and the complete proposal without losing other conversation or task state
Use atomic writes, pre-write validation, backups, and stale-source checks, and expose a recovery action when a write fails
Show exact changed paths and preserve unrelated user edits when applying agent output
Add tests for multi-file patches, rejected changes, stale versions, backup restoration, and partial failures

tasks.name: Streaming Conversation, Cancellation, and Session History
tasks.modelRationale: Complex state management, cancellation races, session persistence. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini) handles this well. Escalate for edge cases.
deliverables: Stream model text, plan updates, tool calls, approvals, and verification results as distinct conversation events
Support stopping an active run, cancelling pending work, retrying failed steps, and resuming a recoverable session
Persist and restore named conversation sessions with their workspace, task, model, context references, and change outcomes
Keep session state isolated by workspace and provide clear handling for missing or changed referenced files
Add tests for interrupted streams, cancellation races, retries, persistence, and session isolation

tasks.name: Post-Edit Verification and Repair Loop
tasks.modelRationale: Verification orchestration, retry logic, failure recovery. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini) for initial reasoning. Escalate for complex repairs.
deliverables: Run the selected linter and relevant tests after accepted edits, using the active workspace's configured commands
Associate verification output with the change and report pass, fail, skipped, or unavailable without converting failures into success
Optionally feed bounded verification errors back into the agent for a user-approved repair attempt with a retry limit
Preserve the pre-change backup and provide recovery guidance when verification fails or an automated repair cannot recover
Add tests for clean passes, failures, missing tools, retry exhaustion, and accurate final status

tasks.name: Provider Privacy, Usage, and Cost Controls
tasks.modelRationale: Budget enforcement, usage tracking, privacy controls. glm-5 (equivalent to o1-mini) for financial/security logic reasoning.
deliverables: Show the active provider/model and whether each request is local or sends workspace context to a remote service
Enforce configurable per-run and daily token, request, and cost budgets before starting model work
Display usage, estimated cost, budget remaining, and rate-limit state for each session without exposing credentials
Allow local-only policy and ensure cloud fallback cannot occur when the workspace disallows remote processing
Add tests for budget rejection, local-only enforcement, usage accounting, and secret-safe reporting

tasks.name: Coding Agent End-to-End Acceptance and Reliability
tasks.modelRationale: Complex integration testing, contract verification. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini) for most cases. glm-5 if deep reasoning needed.
deliverables: Define acceptance workflows for analyze, select tasks, plan, assign agents, approve tools, review diffs, apply edits, and verify results
Add offline end-to-end tests using stubbed providers and temporary repositories, plus provider contract tests where credentials are configured
Verify the agent never fabricates issue data, tool activity, model identity, test results, or successful edits when an operation did not occur
Check keyboard accessibility, responsive layouts, progress/error states, and recovery after server or provider failure
Document setup, package.json linter discovery, task file formats, model configuration, permissions, privacy, troubleshooting, and supported limitations

tasks.name: Documentation Link Ingestion and Evidence Context
tasks.modelRationale: URL fetching, caching, content extraction - straightforward HTTP operations. DeepSeek V4-Flash is cost-optimal.
deliverables: Accept explicit documentation URLs from imported tasks or user input
Fetch, validate, cache, and refresh documentation content
Restrict requests according to allowed-domain, network, and privacy policy
Extract relevant sections and attach source URLs to the task context
Show which documentation sources were used before implementation
Handle unavailable, invalid, or blocked documentation links with actionable errors

tasks.name: Task Scope Analysis and Decomposition Gate
tasks.modelRationale: CRITICAL: Requirement analysis, complexity classification, decomposition. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini, 7/10 reasoning) surprisingly capable. glm-5 for deep analysis.
deliverables: Classify tasks as atomic, bounded multi-file, broad, ambiguous, or multi-requirement
Detect multiple independent outcomes, excessive file scope, missing acceptance criteria, and unresolved dependencies
Generate proposed subtasks for broad or compound requirements
Ask the user to split or approve decomposition before code changes begin
Prevent implementation when the task scope is insufficiently defined
Add deterministic tests for atomic, broad, ambiguous, and compound task examples

tasks.name: Task-Driven Code Generation Workflow
tasks.modelRationale: CRITICAL: Multi-file generation planning. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini) for most cases. glm-5/R1 if generation complexity exceeds expectations.
deliverables: Build an implementation context from the selected task, deliverables, dependencies, acceptance criteria, repository instructions, code, and documentation evidence
Generate a reviewable plan containing affected files, implementation steps, risks, and expected checks
Generate structured multi-file patches from an approved task plan
Preserve task IDs and documentation references throughout planning, generation, review, and execution
Require user approval before writing generated code
Add offline tests using stubbed models and temporary repositories

tasks.name: Requirement Traceability and Acceptance Validation
tasks.modelRationale: Requirement mapping, validation logic. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini) handles this. Escalate to glm-4-plus for complex traceability.
deliverables: Map each task requirement and acceptance criterion to planned changes
Map acceptance criteria to tests, lint commands, builds, or other verification checks
Report unmet, satisfied, skipped, and unverifiable criteria separately
Prevent a task from being reported complete when required checks were not executed
Generate a final implementation report containing changed files, documentation sources, validation results, and remaining risks
Add tests proving incomplete or failed acceptance criteria cannot produce a successful completion status

tasks.name: Pipeline Catalog and Execution Ledger
tasks.modelRationale: CRITICAL: Schema design, event store architecture. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini) surprisingly capable. Escalate to glm-4-plus for foundational design.
deliverables: Define a registry of named pipelines with stable pipeline IDs, versions, stages, inputs, outputs, and verification checks
Persist every pipeline run with run ID, task ID, workspace, timestamps, status, stage results, errors, and cancellation state
Record model, provider, token, cost, documentation sources, tool calls, changed files, and validation results when applicable
Store execution records in a workspace-scoped append-only JSONL or SQLite event store with retention and redaction controls
Expose querying and export for a task, pipeline, session, date range, or failed stage
Add tests proving incomplete or failed pipeline runs cannot be reported as completed

tasks.name: Workspace Quality Analysis Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: Pipeline implementation after T024. DeepSeek V4-Flash is optimal for applying established patterns. 70% cost savings.
deliverables: Implement the end-to-end analysis pipeline over the active workspace and selected files
Use the selected project's tools and package configuration rather than the tool's own package configuration
Return stable issue, summary, statistics, and pipeline-run identifiers
Record each stage, tool command, duration, output status, and normalized issue count in the execution ledger
Add offline tests for successful, partially unavailable, empty, and failed linter runs

tasks.name: Issue Categorization and Enrichment Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: Category mapping, enrichment logic - deterministic classification. DeepSeek V4-Flash is cost-effective.
deliverables: Define the enrichment contract shared by CLI, extension, UI, reports, and fix engines
Preserve original linter evidence while adding category, severity, priority, fixability, and tags
Record classification decisions and rejected or filtered issues for auditability
Add deterministic tests for all supported issue categories and severity mappings

tasks.name: Rule and AI Auto-Fix Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: Complex fallback strategy, validation, rollback logic. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini, 7/10 reasoning) for initial design. Escalate for complex scenarios.
deliverables: Implement explicit rule-only, AI-only, local-first, cloud-fallback, and manual-review strategies
Record every attempted fixer, confidence decision, backup, patch, validation result, and rollback
Preserve unrelated user edits and reject stale or unsafe changes
Add tests for success, unavailable providers, fallback policy, partial failure, rollback, and dry-run execution

tasks.name: AI Issue Resolution Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: CRITICAL: Multi-stage research, context aggregation. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini) for initial stages. glm-5/R1 for complex reasoning phases.
deliverables: Instrument the existing issue-classifier, context analyzer, searchers, aggregator, prompt builder, executors, line editor, and recovery loop as one named pipeline
Persist prompt metadata and source references without storing secrets or unnecessary source content
Record model requirement, selected provider, fallback decisions, token usage, cost, and final edit outcome
Add pipeline tests for local success, cloud fallback, missing model, search failure, parse failure, and recovery exhaustion

tasks.name: AI Code Review Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: Pipeline instrumentation, finding normalization. DeepSeek V4-Flash is cost-optimal for this implementation pattern.
deliverables: Instrument AICodeReviewAssistant as a structured review pipeline with bounded context and focus areas
Normalize findings with evidence locations, severity, confidence, recommendations, provider, and model
Record review input boundaries and output findings without claiming execution that did not occur
Add tests for truncation, provider failure, malformed review output, and structured finding generation

tasks.name: Continuous Watch and Auto-Fix Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: File watching, debouncing, event publishing. DeepSeek V4-Flash for event-driven implementation.
deliverables: Instrument FileWatcher events, debouncing, changed-file analysis, and optional auto-fix as a pipeline
Prevent duplicate or overlapping runs for the same file and preserve cancellation state
Publish live pipeline status to configured UI or websocket consumers
Add tests for new files, excluded files, rapid changes, watcher errors, and auto-fix disabled mode

tasks.name: CI Build Monitoring and Quality Gate Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: CI integration, regression detection, gate logic. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini) for most cases. Escalate for complex threshold reasoning.
deliverables: Instrument BuildMonitor from CI detection through metrics, gates, regressions, history, reports, and exit status
Persist build and pipeline run IDs together so reports can be correlated with source and task context
Record gate decisions and distinguish unavailable checks from passing checks
Add tests for local and supported CI providers, first-build history, regressions, gate failures, and report failures

tasks.name: Multi-Language Analyzer and Plugin Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: Plugin architecture, safe load/unload, contract design. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini) for initial design. Escalate for complex interactions.
deliverables: Define a common analyzer pipeline contract for built-in and plugin-provided languages
Record language, plugin version, external tools, diagnostics, degraded states, and normalized output
Support safe plugin load, unload, reload, and failure isolation
Add contract tests across JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, Python, Go, Rust, PHP, and Ruby adapters

tasks.name: Security Scanning Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: Security logic, secret redaction, risk scoring. glm-5 (equivalent to o1-mini) for security-critical reasoning. Escalate to glm-5-plus if needed.
deliverables: Unify vulnerability, secret, and dependency scanners behind one security pipeline contract
Record scanner versions, scope, findings, redacted evidence, risk scores, and gate decisions
Ensure secrets are redacted from execution records and model context
Add tests for detection, suppression, false-positive handling, and unavailable dependency databases

tasks.name: Performance and Quality Metrics Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: Metric calculation, aggregation, threshold checks. DeepSeek V4-Flash is cost-optimal for algorithmic work.
deliverables: Unify complexity, duplicate, performance, and quality calculations into a repeatable metrics pipeline
Record metric definitions, scopes, thresholds, baselines, and comparison history
Distinguish missing metrics from zero-valued metrics
Add tests for threshold crossings, empty projects, malformed source, and historical comparisons

tasks.name: VS Code Diagnostics and Quick-Fix Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: VS Code API integration, diagnostics mapping. DeepSeek V4-Flash is optimal for well-documented extension patterns.
deliverables: Instrument AqtService, diagnostics provider, code actions, status bar, and webview as one extension pipeline
Keep issue identity stable from analysis through diagnostic display and fix action
Record command, issue, user approval, fix result, and refreshed diagnostic state
Add offline extension tests for activation, analysis, diagnostics, quick fixes, errors, and refresh

tasks.name: Chat UI and WebSocket Interaction Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: WebSocket protocol, message routing, event handling. DeepSeek V4-Flash for standard patterns.
deliverables: Define message, progress, approval, error, cancellation, and result event contracts for the chat UI and websocket server
Correlate every UI action with a workspace, session, task, and pipeline run ID
Persist resumable conversation and pipeline events without duplicating sensitive source content
Add tests for reconnects, malformed messages, concurrent sessions, cancellation, and provider failure

tasks.name: CLI Command Execution Pipelines
tasks.modelRationale: CLI argument parsing, command dispatch - standard CLI patterns. DeepSeek V4-Flash is cost-optimal.
deliverables: Define common lifecycle and result contracts for analyze, fix, generate-fixes, watch, monitor, and UI commands
Record command arguments with secrets redacted, selected configuration, stages, output format, and exit status
Ensure CLI output never reports unavailable work as completed
Add command-level tests for success, invalid arguments, missing tools, dry-run, and failure exit codes

tasks.name: Dashboard Reporting and Trend Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: Data aggregation, trend calculation. DeepSeek V4-Flash handles data processing patterns well.
deliverables: Build dashboard views from persisted pipeline and quality records rather than transient process state
Show run status, issue trends, gate history, fix outcomes, model usage, and verification results
Preserve source pipeline IDs and timestamps in dashboard data and exports
Add tests for empty, partial, historical, and corrupted report data

tasks.name: Pipeline Replay and Contract Testing
tasks.modelRationale: Test framework design, contract validation, replay logic. glm-4 (equivalent to gpt-4o-mini) for most cases. Escalate for complex testing scenarios.
deliverables: Define versioned contracts for pipeline events, stage inputs, stage outputs, errors, and final results
Replay recorded runs with external tools and model providers replaced by deterministic stubs
Detect missing, reordered, duplicated, or fabricated stage events
Add regression fixtures for every registered pipeline and document schema migration behavior

tasks.name: Documentation Generation and Publishing Pipeline
tasks.modelRationale: Template-based generation, link validation, publishing. DeepSeek V4-Flash is cost-optimal for content generation patterns.
deliverables: Generate implementation notes, API references, setup guides, acceptance reports, and task completion summaries from approved task context
Preserve requirement IDs, pipeline run IDs, documentation citations, and generated-file provenance
Validate links, code examples, status claims, and archive placement before publishing
Require user approval for generated documentation changes and record rejected or revised drafts
Add offline tests for generated summaries, citations, stale requirements, invalid links, and archive decisions
